jurisdiction.name: Honduras
jurisdiction.overview: Nationally published records appear separately from applicable EU-level records. The landscape, historical relationships and legal applicability remain under document-level review.

narrative.summary: Honduras has no national AI law, AI strategy or official AI guidance, and no general data protection law. The only traces are a data protection bill pending since 2015, a banking regulator (CNBS) questionnaire on financial institutions' use of AI, and government announcements of AI pilot projects with the Inter-American Development Bank and the Government of Korea.
lead_institutions: Instituto de Acceso a la Información Pública (IAIP)
Comisión Nacional de Bancos y Seguros (CNBS)
narrative.review_notes: A follow-up check on 18 October 2026 covered the National Congress and digital government agency (DIGER) websites, which show no AI law, bill or AI policy document. Not yet verified from the official text: any AI-related material of the information access institute. The data protection bill, the banking regulator's AI questionnaire and government AI projects remain tracked as leads.

coverage_audit.no_material_found_note: National sources in Honduras were searched, including Congress, the official gazette, the presidency, ministries and regulators, and no qualifying AI-governance document was found in any category. Honduras has no general data protection law; a pending bill and a banking regulator questionnaire on AI use are listed as leads. Several official sites, including Congress, the transparency and data protection institute and the digital-government sites, were unavailable and remain to be checked.

Coverage note (original): Technical review notes: tier B/C batch run 2026-10-12, one agent, national level only (PROTOCOL §6), about 25-minute time box. congresonacional.hn TLS error / 503; iaip.gob.hn proxy 502; gobiernodigital.gob.hn no response; diger.gob.hn 403; enag.gob.hn (La Gaceta) no full-text search. leads.title: Anteproyecto de Ley de Protección de Datos Personales
leads.issuing_authority: Instituto de Acceso a la Información Pública (IAIP) / Congreso Nacional
leads.note: Pending. Honduras has no general data protection law; the IAIP first submitted a draft to the Congreso Nacional in 2015 and presented an updated draft to deputies in 2024. Secondary sources report it still awaiting a committee opinion (dictamen) in August 2026. No official text found online (iaip.gob.hn unreachable; congresonacional.hn returned errors). Record the law once published in La Gaceta. Re-checked 2026-10-18: Congress website opens but no bill list could be searched; IAIP sites still unreachable.

leads.title: Uso de Herramientas Tecnológicas que Incorporan Inteligencia Artificial (CNBS)
leads.english_title: Use of Technological Tools Incorporating Artificial Intelligence (CNBS questionnaire)
leads.issuing_authority: Comisión Nacional de Bancos y Seguros (CNBS)
leads.note: Page on the CNBS website (https://www.cnbs.gob.hn/uso-de-herramientas-tecnologicas-que-incorporan-inteligencia-artificial/) that embeds only a Microsoft Forms questionnaire, apparently surveying AI use; the form content could not be loaded and no rule, guidance text or stated publication date is on the page. Information-gathering, not an AI instrument; re-check for any resulting CNBS AI guidance or norm. CNBS's IT/cybersecurity and technology-risk norms do not address AI. Re-checked 2026-10-18: page still carries no rule or guidance text.

leads.title: Mesa técnica Gobierno–BID para la simplificación administrativa con inteligencia artificial
leads.english_title: Government–IDB technical working group on AI-based administrative simplification
leads.issuing_authority: Secretaría de Estado de la Presidencia
leads.note: Announced on sep.gob.hn ('Honduras modernizará el Estado con apoyo de la Inteligencia Artificial', 2026): a technical table with the IDB to pilot an AI platform that reviews laws, regulations and procedures for red tape. Government use-of-AI project announcement; no governing document found. Promote only if a decree/PCM or policy document is issued.

leads.title: Proyecto de ciberseguridad CONATEL–UIT sobre riesgos de la inteligencia artificial
leads.english_title: CONATEL–ITU cybersecurity project on AI risks
leads.note: Announced intent reported in secondary sources (2026); nothing on conatel.gob.hn (site search for 'inteligencia' returned no results). Also, a National Cybersecurity Strategy promised in the Digital Government Plan 2023-2026 has not been found. Re-check. Re-checked 2026-10-18: CONATEL site search still shows no AI material.

leads.title: DIGER implementará el uso de Inteligencia Artificial para facilitar el acceso a programas sociales (apoyo del Gobierno de Corea)
leads.english_title: DIGER AI pilot to ease access to social programmes, with support from the Government of Korea
leads.note: Press-release PDF in the DIGER documents portal (https://www.diger.gob.hn/documentos), published 13 Oct 2026: a pilot AI tool, coordinated with SEDESOL, to inform older people and persons with disabilities about procedures without requesting personal data. Government use-of-AI project; no governing document. DIGER's PCM-004-2026 digital competencies do not mention AI. Promote only if a policy or rule is issued.
